svg.title: Six-Petal Lily — shaped petals
svg.desc: Bloom 90 mm across · stem 250 mm. Curl each petal lengthways around a pencil, fold on the base score. Glue the six petals in a ring, notched tips facing out. Bend the thin stamens and glue them into the centre disc; tape the two slim leaves onto the stem.
